title: Document the existing Swift Pinata API at complete SpecSync coverage
description: Document the existing Swift Pinata API at complete SpecSync coverage
acceptance_criteria: An active canonical companion covers all six Swift implementation files and every parser-visible export at 100 percent; source-backed requirements map credentials, configuration, file operations, swaps, groups, response models, authentication, retries, and errors to deterministic native tests or the explicitly credential-gated integration boundary; strict SpecSync scores A without scaffolds; Sources and Tests remain unchanged
